ideas.text: HTML5 document with UTF-8 encoding and responsive viewport
page title identifies this as a decompile reader
light and dark color themes defined as CSS custom properties
system sans-serif and monospace font stacks defined as variables
all elements use border-box sizing; transitions disabled for reduced-motion preference
body uses theme background, ink color, system sans font, and antialiased rendering
pane component has surface background, border, and rounded corners
main layout is a centered flex column with max width, padding, and full viewport height
left column is a fixed-width sticky panel holding stacked sections
right column fills remaining space
project bar shows a back caret, project name, and version selector in a row
ideas list scrolls vertically within a max height with vertical padding
each idea row shows a monospace ID badge and text, is clickable, and has a left colored border for diff status
removed ideas shown struck-through, muted, and non-clickable
code panel shows a filename bar above a horizontally scrollable code area
each code row shows a line number gutter and pre-formatted text in monospace
collapsed ranges of hidden lines or ideas shown as a small pill badge
hover state highlights rows with a tinted wash background
flow state highlights all connected rows with the same tinted wash
selected row and its connected rows highlighted with solid accent background and white text
previously-selected moved idea highlighted with a distinct moved color
blank code lines without an idea mapping are non-interactive
project picker is a centered column of cards hidden by default
graph view panel with a canvas and tooltip is hidden by default
page structured with head containing styles and body containing markup and script
HTML entities escaped to prevent injection when rendering user content
global state tracks project list, active project, version list, active version, ideas, code lines, diff, mappings, and selection
on startup the app fetches a projects manifest and opens the first project automatically
failure message tells user to serve the folder rather than open the file directly
clicking the project bar opens the project picker unless the version selector was clicked
changing the version selector updates the active version and reloads data
clicking outside any interactive row or panel clears the selection
opening a project resets version to latest, updates displayed name, and fetches versions then loads data
available versions discovered by probing numbered history folders sequentially until one is missing
version dropdown populated with latest plus discovered versions in reverse order
data path switches between project root for latest and a numbered history subfolder for older versions
loading a version fetches code, ideas, and diff files in parallel and updates global state
right-clicking a moved idea navigates to the previous version with that idea pre-selected
showing the project picker hides main editor panels and renders clickable project cards
forward and reverse maps link each idea to its source ideas and code lines for bidirectional traversal
each idea's depth computed as one more than max depth of its sources, with iterative topological resolution and cycle guard
graph walk collects all reachable nodes from a starting node by following a given adjacency map
flow set for a node is the union of everything reachable going up through sources and down through dependents
an idea or code line is tagged as added or moved based on diff data
ideas rendered sorted by depth descending, with non-flow ideas collapsed into fold pills and removed ideas appended at the bottom
code lines rendered in order with non-flow lines collapsed into fold pills
each rendered row gets click, right-click, and hover handlers that trigger selection or flow highlighting
hovering highlights all rows in the hovered node's flow set without locking a selection
clicking a row toggles it as the selection; clicking same row again or outside deselects
both panels re-rendered together whenever selection changes, filtered to selected node's flow set
graph state tracks nodes, edges, scale, pan offset, hovered node, and a wired flag
CSS custom property values read at runtime to use theme colors in canvas drawing
nodes laid out in a layered grid with depth on vertical axis and sibling index on horizontal axis; removed ideas placed at the bottom
graph edges built from source references between ideas
initial scale and pan center the graph to fit within the canvas
node fill color shifts along a hue and lightness gradient based on ratio of source connections to the maximum
canvas redrawn by clearing, drawing edges as lines, then drawing each node as a circle with ID label and truncated text caption; diff status and hover state affect stroke color and width
hit testing converts mouse coordinates to graph space and finds first node within a fixed radius
graph canvas supports scroll-to-zoom centered on cursor and click-drag panning or node dragging
mouse movement over the graph updates hover state, shows tooltip with node's diff status, and redraws
leaving the canvas clears hover state and hides the tooltip
entire script runs in an IIFE to avoid polluting the global scope
ideas and code lines linked by explicit source references forming a directed acyclic graph
selecting a node filters both panels to show only connected ideas and code lines, collapsing the rest
diff information annotates ideas as added, moved, or removed compared to the previous version
multiple named versions of a project's analysis stored in numbered history folders and navigable via a dropdown
two-column layout: sticky left panel listing ideas and right panel showing source code
project picker screen replaces the editor and lets the user switch between multiple projects
color-coded borders and background highlights distinguish diff status, hover, flow, and selection
interactive zoomable and pannable graph view shows ideas as nodes colored by connectivity, with edges linking sources and tooltips showing diff status
web reader visualizes layered ideas extracted from a codebase, linked to source lines, with version history, interactive flow highlighting, and a graph view
